title: Diffyscan Overlay
description: MethodDescription for a Diffyscan verification cohort. Addresses, contract names, and source repository/commit are resolved from ledger.json via deploymentIds; this file must not restate deployment addresses.

$schema.description: Relative or absolute reference to this overlay schema.

overlayId.description: Stable identifier for this Diffyscan cohort; used as the generated config basename.

description.description: Optional human-readable note about the cohort's verification purpose.

deploymentIds.description: Ledger deploymentId values included in this Diffyscan run. Must share one networkId and one source.repositoryUrl+commit.

explorer_hostname.description: Block explorer API hostname for Diffyscan (for example api-optimistic.etherscan.io).

explorer_token_env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the explorer API token.

explorer_chain_id.description: Optional explicit explorer chain id. When omitted, eip155 networkIds yield the numeric chain id automatically.

github_repo.description: Diffyscan github_repo fields that are not owned by the ledger. url and commit are always taken from the selected deployments' source.

relative_root.description: Repository-relative root Diffyscan should use when locating sources.

dependencies.description: Diffyscan dependency map (name to {url, commit, relative_root}).

fail_on_bytecode_comparison_error.description: Only meaningful when false (Diffyscan already defaults to true).

bytecode_comparison.description: Optional Diffyscan bytecode_comparison section. Address-keyed maps use deploymentId keys and are rewritten to addresses at render time.

deployment_from.description: Map of deployable deploymentId to deployer deploymentId; both sides are rewritten to addresses.

allowed_diffs.description: Optional Diffyscan allowed_diffs section. Address-keyed maps use deploymentId keys and are rewritten to addresses at render time.

deploymentIdKeyedMap.description: Object keyed by ledger deploymentId; values are forwarded to Diffyscan after keys are rewritten to addresses.
